decisions.scenario: Booking a moderately priced guesthouse with free parking

turns.text: Do you have a preferred area of the city?

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: No, I don't have an area preference, but I'd like free parking.

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: Acorn Guest House is moderately priced, has four stars, and offers free parking. Would you like me to book it?

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: Yes, please book it for six people for two nights starting on Tuesday.

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: The booking is confirmed. Your reference number is WZRKRXGZ. Is there anything else I can help with?

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: No, that's all. Thank you for your help!
